title: Resolution urging feds to halt Skyport seaplane flights
summary: This resolution calls on the National Transportation Safety Board and the Federal Aviation Administration to suspend all seaplane flights at the Skyport Seaplane Terminal on Manhattan's East Side until a full safety review is completed. It cites a July 5, 2026 hard landing of a seaplane in the East River that injured two passengers and required a Fire Department rescue of all eight people aboard. The terminal recorded 2,719 enplanements in 2025.
